verdict.rationale: Unleash documents self-hosting Open Source or Enterprise in your own environment with Docker, which lets you decide where flag data lives. Unleash Edge keeps targeting PII inside the Edge node and never sends it to Unleash Cloud or the upstream instance. External impact metrics stay in your own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics, so data locality is achievable mainly through self-managed deployment. missing for 10: documented region or data-residency selection for the hosted Unleash Cloud offering, explicit residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration.
